recognize_zh: 整片單調、互相黏合的中大型腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫性浸潤，右側有地圖狀壞死與出血；形態上是高度惡性的大細胞淋巴瘤，需靠 CD138/MUM1 陽性、CD20 陰性與 EBER 陽性才能確認為漿母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of monotonous medium-to-large cells
Round nuclei with vesicular chromatin; some cells with eccentric nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Delicate intervening capillaries and thin fibrous septa
Scattered clear spaces, possibly tingible-body macrophages
Large geographic zone of necrosis with hemorrhage on the right
describe_en: H&E section at low-to-medium power shows effacement by a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of monotonous medium-to-large neoplastic cells with round nuclei, vesicular chromatin and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, some with eccentric nuclei. Delicate vessels traverse the tumor, and scattered clear spaces suggest tingible-body macrophages. A large geographic area of necrosis with hemorrhage is present on the right. Plasmacytoid detail is limited at this magnification; with the supporting CD138-positive, EBER-positive immunoprofile, findings are consistent with EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Can look identical on H&E but expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks the CD138+/MUM1+ plasmacytic phenotype.
Shows a starry-sky pattern of medium-sized cells with squared-off cytoplasm, CD20+/CD10+/BCL6+, near-100% Ki-67 and MYC::IGH without plasmacytic markers.
Similar phenotype; favors myeloma if there is M-protein, marrow clonal plasma cells and EBV negativity.
Cohesive nests on H&E may mimic; keratin or S100/SOX10 positivity and lack of CD45/CD138/MUM1 separate them.
